svg.title: dev-loop-flow — the full loop, redrawn from source
svg.desc: Flowchart of dev-loop-flow.mmd: nine phases from framing through implementation, tests and shipping; a nine-lane parallel review round split into always-applicable and diff-gated lanes; a triage gate that skips the fix phase entirely when nothing was accepted; the loop-or-exit gate bounding the round; and a staging-integrity gate in Phase 9 that halts before a mismatched diff is ever pushed.
